title: Choose your MediSummarize workspace
question: Compare the image mockups. Choose a direction, or add a short steer for changes. All records shown are synthetic and experiment scores are unrun.

options.label: A · Evidence journal
options.thesis: A precise plum workspace that keeps every summary beside its evidence.
options.viewport: Sidebar, record header, document list, and linked summary/source panes; experiment runs below.
options.risk: More editorial character; dense evidence needs careful type sizing.

raised.raise: Shared pane alignment makes source comparison easier.
Every summary claim has an adjacent source action.
Statuses align in compact, readable columns.

options.label: B · Clinical clarity
options.thesis: A calm teal workspace with a clear document-to-evidence path.
options.viewport: A compact sidebar, document strip, wide evidence review, and separate experiment navigation.
options.risk: The most familiar option; resembles established healthcare software.

options.label: C · Reference desk
options.thesis: An ivory reading workspace with strong ink text and vermilion source anchors.
options.viewport: Standard top navigation, document list, and two readable evidence columns with citation markers.
options.case: Strong fit for academic source review; less immediately familiar as clinical software.
options.risk: Reading-oriented typography can feel less like a modern clinical app.

canonCard.label: Conventional product UI
canonCard.thesis: A familiar blue-and-white application, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Standard sidebar, record tabs, document table, and source review panels.
canonCard.risk: Clear and familiar, with less distinctive character.
